description: This file defines a report class 'OpportunitySummaryBySalesStage' for generating opportunity summary data by sales stage, including methods for data retrieval, processing, and chart generation within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: OpportunitySummaryBySalesStage
classes.description: Class responsible for generating opportunity summary reports grouped by sales stage, with capabilities for data filtering, aggregation, and visualization.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that initializes and runs the OpportunitySummaryBySalesStage report with optional filters.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report with optional filters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to generate report columns, data, and chart data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines report columns based on filters.

methods.name: set_sales_stage_columns
methods.description: Adds columns for each sales stage based on the data based on filter.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves and processes opportunity data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data_query
methods.description: Executes database queries to fetch opportunity data, with different logic for 'Number' and 'Amount' data types.

methods.name: get_rows
methods.description: Formats the raw query data into report rows.

methods.name: get_formatted_data
methods.description: Processes raw data into a structured format grouped by opportunity owner, source, or opportunity type.

methods.name: set_formatted_data_based_on_sales_stage
methods.description: Helper to accumulate counts or amounts per sales stage.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds filter conditions for database queries.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for chart visualization based on sales stages.

methods.name: currency_conversion
methods.description: Converts currency amounts using cached exchange rates.

methods.name: get_default_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the default currency for the company.

methods.name: convert_to_base_currency
methods.description: Converts all opportunity amounts to the company's base currency.
